title: Baba Baba Hussain
body:
Baba Baba Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Hussain, hussain,hussain, hussain..(4)
Sham-e-ghareebaa al amaa, phaila hua har su dhua
Nauha kuna saidaniya, ghash me pada hai ek natawa
Pyasi sakina nauhakhwaa
<<MINI>>
Baba baba Husain..(3)
Sakina ki ati thi sada.. Baba baba Husain..(3)
Hussain, hussain,hussain, hussain, hussain, hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Jalte hue khaime idhar, lashe tadapte the udhar
Karbobala ki khaak par, boli sakina rakhke sar
Baba suno meri fugha
<<MINI>>
Baba baba Husain..(3)
Sakina ki ati thi sada.. Baba baba Husain..(3)
Hussain, hussain,hussain, hussain, hussain, hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Bade nabi taraaj hai, sholo ka har su raaj hai
Haye kafan ke waste, baba mera mohtaj hai
Kitna bada hai imtehaa
<<MINI>>
Baba baba Husain..(3)
Sakina ki ati thi sada.. Baba baba Husain..(3)
Hussain, hussain,hussain, hussain, hussain, hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Shame masaeb aagai, andhi ghamo ki cha gai
Mai janibe darya gai, lashe chacha tharra gai
Kano se khoo dekha rawa
<<MINI>>
Baba baba Husain..(3)
Sakina ki ati thi sada.. Baba baba Husain..(3)
Hussain, hussain,hussain, hussain, hussain, hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Rukhsar nile hogae, itne tamache hail age
Baba khuda ke waste, mujhko lagalo seene se
Dukhti hai meri pasliyaa
<<MINI>>
Baba baba Husain..(3)
Sakina ki ati thi sada.. Baba baba Husain..(3)
Hussain, hussain,hussain, hussain, hussain, hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Tapti zami jalti hawa, ae maqtal-e-karbobala
Ek dopaher me kya hua, loota gaya kunba mera
Chadar na sar pe saaebaa
<<MINI>>
Baba baba Husain..(3)
Sakina ki ati thi sada.. Baba baba Husain..(3)
Hussain, hussain,hussain, hussain, hussain, hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek reesma bara gale, kuch is tarah bandhe gaye
Har aati jaati saans bhi, jaise koi khanjar chale
Nazuk gale me reesma
<<MINI>>
Baba baba Husain..(3)
Sakina ki ati thi sada.. Baba baba Husain..(3)
Hussain, hussain,hussain, hussain, hussain, hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Rassi me baba bandh gae, taza sitam hone ko hai
Zanjeer lae ashqiyaa, beemar aabid ke liye
Pehna rahe hai bediyaa
<<MINI>>
Baba baba Husain..(3)
Sakina ki ati thi sada.. Baba baba Husain..(3)
Hussain, hussain,hussain, hussain, hussain, hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya sarwar-o-rehan ham, batlae rudade sitam
Nazuk se dil ke ranjo ghum, kehti rahi wo dam ba dam
Ab tum kaha aur hum kaha
<<MINI>>
Baba baba Husain..(3)
Sakina ki ati thi sada.. Baba baba Husain..(3)
Hussain, hussain,hussain, hussain, hussain, hussain
